item.description:
Queen – The Studio Collection [US Pressed 18 Color Vinyl Box Set] (2015) [LP] [Hi-Res]



2015 | Rock | FLAC, Lossless 24-96 | 13.77 Gb

Universal Music are proud to release all hit Queen studio albums sourced from the original master tapes mastered by Bob Ludwig. This 18 vinyl LP box set comes with a lavishly illustrated 12 x 12 inch 108 page hardback book which features introductions to each album, quotes from Queen themselves, hand-written lyrics, rare photograhs, memorabilia, and information on singles and videos.
